from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A capital surplus-related line item extracted from one company's financial statements."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The registrant/company name from this filing")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the equity line item as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for this line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this filing covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_line_items: list[EquityLineItem]
